Embedding request with multiple input strings returns one embedding object per input

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.embeddingRequestFromJson("{\"input\":[\"Hello\",\"World\"],\"model\":\"text-embedding-3-small\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.embed(request: _request)
debugPrint(result.data)
debugPrint(result.data[0].embedding)
```
